thesis.title: From opportunity to a structured, executable transaction.
thesis.intro: The model brings together disciplines that usually sit apart. Strategy connects to analysis; analysis to valuation; valuation to structure; structure to capital; and capital to negotiation and execution.
thesis.principle: Not only to identify good opportunities, but to determine which transaction makes sense, how to finance it, how to structure it, how to execute it, and how to protect capital throughout.

capabilities.title: Origination
capabilities.text: Identification of companies, assets, projects, acquisition opportunities, capital needs, investors, lenders, buyers and strategic partners.

capabilities.title: Analysis & due diligence

capabilities.title: Capital structuring

capabilities.title: M&A & transactions
capabilities.text: Acquisitions, divestments, buyer or target search, financial analysis, negotiation, due diligence and execution support.

capabilities.title: Capital raising
capabilities.text: Preparation of opportunities and introduction to private investors, family offices, funds and other capital sources within the applicable regulatory framework.

capabilities.title: Industrial & real assets
capabilities.text: Structuring and development of mining, industrial, energy, infrastructure and real-estate projects with a financial and operating view.

capabilities.title: Cross-border development
capabilities.text: Market entry, joint ventures, local establishment, partners, distributors, commercial representation, roadshows and international execution.

about.title: Who we are
about.subtitle: Accumulated experience. Institutional capacity from the outset.
about.body: NAHU Capital consolidates the professional experience of its founders within a new corporate structure designed to operate with financial discipline, transactional capability, sector knowledge and international reach. Together, it brings more than 75 years of work in corporate finance, audit, banking, M&A, mining, energy, infrastructure, industrial and real-estate development, private investment and international expansion.
about.differential: The group’s capacity does not rest only on identifying opportunities, but on determining which ones make sense, how they should be structured, what capital they require, what their risks are, and under what conditions they can be executed.

portfolio.model: NAHU Capital is built as a Mexican platform with an international mandate to connect capital, companies, assets, projects, markets and opportunities. Its purpose is to assemble transactions that are financially viable, strategically coherent and executable, developing over time the vehicles and structures permitted by its corporate purpose and applicable regulation.
